notes: Agent-foundation release: the assistant now knows what the product around it can do — a curated capability map is injected into its system prompt as optional reference material, with the philosophy that governs it (loyal to one master, honest above all, approval gates sacred). It can also propose configuration changes on the owner's behalf: the new settings tool files a bounded plan, and NOTHING is written until the owner approves it in the console's new Agent plans card — approval runs the same validator and the same write core as a hand-typed save, and every proposal shows its validation verdict before the click. Delegation bounds are now owner-configurable (parallel sub-agents 1-5, sub-agent turns 1-25) with the shipped safety range enforced on both sides. A repaint edge where an out-of-option refresh interval could blank the console selector is fixed. Core grows to 2116/2116 tests, console smoke to 454/454, locale packs to 1266 keys per language, and the registered tool catalog to 28.
